WITH vorherige_laeufe AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET
        status      = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text  = 'Durch neuen manuellen Vollabgleich ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'vollabgleich'
      AND status   = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status)
VALUES ('vollabgleich', 'laeuft')
RETURNING run_id, started_at, status;

=WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT
        t.id,
        t.offer,
        t."time",
        t.status,
        CASE WHEN t.owner IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE md5(t.owner) END AS user_ref,
        md5(concat_ws('|', t.offer, t.status, t."time"::text, t.mustpay::text, t.label)) AS payload_hash
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            id      text,
            offer   text,
            "time"  timestamptz,
            status  text,
            owner   text,
            mustpay boolean,
            label   text
         )
),
-- Vor dem Schreiben festhalten, was sich inhaltlich aendert.
kennzahlen AS (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL
               OR b.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.payload_hash
        ) AS geaendert
    FROM eingang e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.booking b ON b.booking_id = e.id
),
geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.booking AS b (
        booking_id, offer_id, status, booking_time, user_ref,
        source, last_synced_at, last_changed_at, payload_hash, is_deleted
    )
    SELECT
        e.id, e.offer, e.status, e."time", e.user_ref,
        'api', now(), now(), e.payload_hash, false
    FROM eingang e
    ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
        offer_id        = EXCLUDED.offer_id,
        status          = EXCLUDED.status,
        booking_time    = EXCLUDED.booking_time,
        user_ref        = EXCLUDED.user_ref,
        last_synced_at  = now(),
        is_deleted      = false,
        last_changed_at = CASE
                              WHEN b.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.payload_hash
                              THEN now()
                              ELSE b.last_changed_at
                          END,
        payload_hash    = EXCLUDED.payload_hash
    RETURNING b.booking_id
),
fehlend AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.booking
    SET is_deleted     = true,
        last_synced_at = now()
    WHERE source       = 'api'
      AND is_deleted   = false
      AND booking_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM eingang)
    RETURNING booking_id
),
lauf AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status           = 'erfolgreich',
        finished_at      = now(),
        bookings_seen    = (SELECT zeilen    FROM kennzahlen),
        bookings_changed = (SELECT geaendert FROM kennzahlen),
        api_calls        = {{ $json.abrufe }}
    WHERE run_id = {{ $json.run_id }}
    RETURNING run_id, status, bookings_seen, bookings_changed, api_calls
)
SELECT
    l.run_id,
    l.status,
    l.bookings_seen    AS gelesen,
    l.bookings_changed AS inhaltlich_geaendert,
    l.api_calls        AS abrufe,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM geschrieben) AS gespeichert,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM fehlend)     AS als_geloescht_markiert
FROM lauf l;
